question.text: Agastya Venture Fund invests INR 15 crore in start-up Chitra AI for a 20% equity stake at post-money valuation. What is the pre-money valuation of Chitra AI?

explanation.text: The Logic: Post-money valuation = Investment / Stake% = 15 / 0.20 = INR 75 crore. Pre-money valuation = Post-money - New Investment = 75 - 15 = INR 60 crore. The Trap: INR 75 crore is the post-money valuation itself. INR 90 crore adds the investment instead of subtracting it. INR 65 crore arises from using a wrong denominator in the post-money calculation. Note: Pre-money and post-money differ exactly by the size of the new investment — confusing the two changes the implied valuation materially.
